headline: Kenvue Increases Quarterly Cash Dividend
summary: SUMMIT, N.J., July 29, 2026--Kenvue Inc. (NYSE: KVUE) today announced that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.21 per share on its common stock, which represents a 1.2 percent increase compared to the prior quarterly dividend. The quarterly dividend is payable on August 26, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on August 12, 2026.
